title: Introduce route-level size quarantine and adaptive chunk-ack window to stabilize streaming toolcalls
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We observed a class of production incidents where unusually large user payloads (multipart uploads or long system prompts with embedded toolcall scaffolding) caused amplification in the gateway streaming path: proxy buffers would coalesce many small frames, then the downstream model path would stall on KV-cache handshakes for function/tool calls, resulting in head-of-line stalls and user-facing stalls during streaming. This PR applies two orthogonal mitigations at the gateway surface: 1) a transient route-level size quarantine that detects and isolates anomalously large requests for separate handling (batch-fallback or immediate reject when configured), and 2) an adaptive chunk-ack window for the streaming proxy that prevents the proxy from holding too many unacked chunks during tool/function handshakes, reducing amplification and stray retries. The goal is to improve streaming stability without changing client-facing APIs; OpenAI-compat behavior is preserved with a small compatibility tweak to chunk framing to avoid double-close race in function-call handoffs. Summary of changes and rationale: - Add a route_quarantine state machine that tracks per-route size spikes and applies a short TTL quarantine (configurable) that routes offending traffic to a batch-fallback path or returns a 413-like hint depending on policy. This reduces the number of pathologically large requests entering low-latency streaming pools. - Implement adaptive ack window in the streaming proxy: the window size reduces automatically when a toolcall handshake is detected (based on stream metadata flags and content heuristics), and grows back after a successful handshake. This prevents buffer amplification during the multi-step toolcall exchange. - Small OpenAI-compat change: tweak chunk_framer to emit a stable terminator frame for function-call streams to avoid ambiguous end-of-streams observed in interop tests. - Observability: add metrics (route_quarantine.count, streaming.ack_window.size, streaming.toolcall.handshakes) and an alert hint to SLO playbook. - Tests: unit coverage for quarantine TTL logic, integration test for simulated toolcall handshake under heavy chunking, and e2e compatibility test against the openai-compat shim. Checklist: - [x] Design review with runtime and gateway (ENG-4122) - [x] Benchmarked basic workloads locally (reduced tail stalls by ~45% in synthetic replay) - [x] Added unit and integration tests - [x] Updated observability and runbooks - [x] Docs entry for gateway tuning (docs/changes/streaming-tuning.md) Commits (high-level): - 9a1c2d: add route_quarantine state machine and config knobs - 3f7b44: implement adaptive ack window and proxy integration - 11b3e7: compat: stable chunk terminator for function-call streams - 5d9f2a: tests + metrics + docs Notes on backward compatibility: The route quarantine is opt-in by default and can be enabled per-route. The adaptive ack window is conservative and defaults to the current window size; only active reductions occur when a handshake pattern is recognized. The OpenAI-compat framer change is additive and preserves previous chunk contents; it only alters the closing sentinel to make toolcall handoffs deterministic. Changed areas (high level): gateway/router/route_quarantine.go, gateway/proxy/stream_buffer.go, gateway/proxy/ack_window.go, compat/openai/chunk_framer.go, api/tests/stream_toolcall_integration.rs, docs/changes/streaming-tuning.md, pkg/config/defaults.yaml, pkg/observability/alerts.yaml Review conversation (selected): - Connor Liu (review): "Question: what stops a client from intentionally triggering the quarantine to force batch-fallback?" - Aisha: "We enforce a short cooldown and circuit flag per-client; policy supports client whitelisting. Also quarantine TTL is low (default 30s) and we emit a debug header that clients can examine. See gateway/router/route_quarantine.go:QuarantinePolicy." - Elena Martinez (request changes): "Please add a histogram for ack_window size; counters alone won't show distribution." - Aisha: "Added histogram metric streaming.ack_window.size_buckets in observability patch; also added a note in runbook about interpreting it." - Rajesh Kumar (approval): "Verified integration test under the allocator stress harness; LGTM once CI green." CI summary: - unit-tests: passed - integration-streaming: initially failed (timing-sensitive flake), rerun -> passed - lint: passed - e2e-openai-compat: passed Merge: squashed and merged to main (squash), merge commit: squashed 4 commits into one. Rollout notes: Gate is controlled by config flag gateway.features.route_quarantine.enabled (default false). Ops can enable in a canary region first; metric route_quarantine.count and streaming.ack_window.size_buckets should be monitored for unexpected spikes. Linked issues: ENG-4122 (design), PM-198 (customer impact follow-up), SUP-3221 (customer repro attached).
